caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular keyboard instrument, resembling a spinet or small harpsichord, standing on four slender, tapered legs that are braced by horizontal supports. The instrument is colored in shades of rich red and brown with yellow-gold outlining accentuating its edges and panels. The front features a keyboard with white and black keys, above which there is a decorated panel with a floral pattern and an oval label at the center. The instrument’s lid is partially open. The overall construction is angular, with clear straight lines and right angles in its structure. A smaller, technical line drawing appears in the lower right corner, showing the instrument from a different perspective with dimensions marked. The background is plain and cream-colored, with a simple rectangular border framing the drawing. There is a handwritten note in the bottom left corner with the artist’s name and date.
title: Piano
